title: The Olde Pink House
scope: The surviving Habersham House at 23 Abercorn Street, Savannah, including the Georgian brick and pink stucco envelope, Doric entry portico, gabled roof and entrance stair.
limitations: Exterior of the standing historic residence and its connected wing. Decorative ironwork and later interior fit-outs are simplified or outside scope.
Unpublished vertical dimensions and secondary window positions are estimated from the survey photographs.
